name: cursor-control
description: Drive Cursor desktop agents from ZCode over CDP and SQLite without touching the foreground UI.

plugins.name: cursor-control
plugins.description: Drive Cursor desktop agents from ZCode over CDP and SQLite: background progress reads, auto-approval of tool calls via Cursor hooks, and message injection into tracked sessions without touching the foreground UI.

description_i18n.en: Drive Cursor desktop agents from ZCode over CDP and SQLite: background progress reads, auto-approval of tool calls via Cursor hooks, and message injection into tracked sessions without touching the foreground UI.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过 CDP 与 SQLite 从 ZCode 无感驱动 Cursor 桌面端 agent：后台读取进度、经 Cursor hooks 自动批放工具调用、向被跟踪会话注入消息（不打扰前台界面）。
